# expand-collapse

The worked example of a row badge that needs expand state without its host
handing it one. It reads `useOptionalTreeListContext()` (returning `null` when
rendered outside a tree) and drives `useSubtreeExpandAll(rows, id, setExpanded)`
for both the `willCollapse` direction and the toggle — the same shape as
`tasks/task-list`'s expand-collapse-all action. It owns only its button; the
state is the `data-view` expand map, reached through the tree primitive's
context rather than an explorer-specific one.

## Plugin reference

- Description: Expand/collapse all descendants button in the explorer plugin tree row.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `Explorer.TreeRowBadge` "expand-collapse" → `ExpandCollapseButton`
  - Uses:
    - `apps/studio/explorer.Explorer`
    - `primitives/css/center.Center`
    - `primitives/tree.TreeItem`
    - `primitives/tree.TreeListContextValue`
    - `primitives/tree.useOptionalTreeListContext`
    - `primitives/tree.useSubtreeExpandAll`
